title: Zero Dollars: 10 Things Locals Do for Free
description: Ten Antwerp rituals with no ticket or purchase attached: sculpture walks, skyline views, river crossings, garden pauses, open-water laps and a few useful indoor escapes.

cards.title: Browse sculpture beneath the trees
cards.subtitle: Middelheim Museum, Wilrijk
cards.notes: Admission to the museum park is free. Seasonal closing times apply, and last entry is 30 minutes before closing.
cards.short_summary: Follow the broad paths between modern and contemporary sculptures, then give whichever work catches you a second look.

cards.title: Ride the escalators to the skyline
cards.subtitle: MAS Boulevard and rooftop panorama, Eilandje
cards.notes: The Boulevard and panorama are free without a ticket; museum galleries require admission. The rooftop’s final section is reached by stairs.
cards.short_summary: Spiral upward past changing displays, red sandstone and rippled glass until the city, Scheldt and docks spread out below.

cards.title: Cross the Scheldt by ferry
cards.subtitle: Steenplein to Linkeroever
cards.notes: The ferry carries pedestrians, cyclists and accompanied wheelchair users free of charge every day. Check the current timetable before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Use the river as the route: board beside Het Steen and step off at the Boeienweide with the city skyline behind you.
cards.source_title: Sint-Anna ferry service extended | Smart Ways to Antwerp

cards.title: Enter the cathedral with local ID
cards.subtitle: Onze-Lieve-Vrouwekathedraal, Handschoenmarkt
cards.notes: Admission is free for residents of Antwerp Province and visitors under 18. Other adults pay admission; bring proof of residency and check service-related closures.
cards.short_summary: Province residents can revisit the cathedral’s nave and art without turning the visit into a once-only occasion.
cards.source_title: Plan your visit | Cathedral of Our Lady Antwerp

cards.title: Run laps on the gravel track
cards.subtitle: Sportcentrum Het Rooi, Berchem
cards.notes: The city lists the illuminated 400-metre athletics track as freely accessible to individual joggers.
cards.short_summary: Trade traffic-light interruptions for measured laps on a proper outdoor track—no club session or day pass required.

cards.entity_name: Park Spoor Noord skate and BMX park
cards.title: Practise a line in the skate bowl
cards.subtitle: Park Spoor Noord, Antwerpen-Noord
cards.notes: The city’s Park Spoor Noord information states that the skate and BMX park is open daily and freely accessible.
cards.short_summary: Bring a board, skates or BMX and repeat the same line until the concrete starts to feel familiar.
cards.source_title: Veel gestelde vragen over Park Spoor Noord | Stad Antwerpen

cards.title: Swim a free half-hour in the dock
cards.subtitle: Bonapartedok, beside the MAS
cards.notes: Seasonal weekend entry is free, but advance reservation is compulsory. Swimmers must be at least 12 and able to swim; weather or water quality can close the site.
cards.short_summary: Choose a 50-metre lane or the recreational zone for an open-water interval framed by quay walls and the MAS.
cards.source_title: 't ZwemDok - zwemmen in het Bonapartedok | Antwerpen

cards.title: Read or work without buying a seat
cards.subtitle: Sixteen neighborhood libraries across Antwerp
cards.notes: City library guidance says the libraries are freely accessible for working or relaxing. Borrowing materials requires a library subscription.
cards.short_summary: Settle in with your own notes or browse on site when home feels cramped and a café purchase feels unnecessary.

cards.title: Pause among medicinal plants
cards.subtitle: Botanical Garden, Leopoldstraat
cards.notes: The city explicitly lists admission as free. The greenhouse is temporarily closed, but the garden remains the central free visit.
cards.short_summary: Take a quiet circuit through the compact botanical collection, where labels turn a short bench break into plant reconnaissance.

cards.title: Visit the farm, maze and playgrounds
cards.subtitle: Rivierenhof, Deurne
cards.notes: The Province’s Antwerp guide identifies the children’s farm, playgrounds, maze and sandpit as free offerings. Individual attractions keep their own access hours.
cards.short_summary: Build an afternoon around the domain’s no-ticket circuit: animals, a maze, sand and room to walk between stops.
cards.source_title: Budgetvriendelijk op stap – Stad Antwerpen | Provincie Antwerpen
